title: Gmail from Claude (draft, then you confirm)
summary: Search, read, summarise and draft replies in your Gmail from the command line. Claude can write anything, but nothing sends until you explicitly confirm.
how_to_use: Ask "check my inbox", "what did X email me?", "draft a reply to that thread". Sending needs --confirm.
requires: Your own Google Cloud OAuth client for the Gmail API (SKILL.md walks through it). Replace you@example.com with your address.
